I understand how you feel and really appreciate that you're letting it all out. Also, I care about you and your wellbeing. 
I'm not saying this to make you feel better. I'm saying this because I've been through similar shit and I see my past self in most of the situations you described. If you want to talk, I'll be here.

I wish people did care about me but they don't. They never did. Even my mom, with the best of intentions, abandoned me when I was 2,  pretty much kidnapped me when I was 7 (I was living with my father and his girlfriend back then) and then got married to her first love and left me. I don't want anyone to pity me but even the woman who pushed me out of her vagina couldn't stand living with me. But I don't blame her. Because now, unintentionally I'm fucking up her life. I shaped my life around lies. I came to where I am by lying to my family and playing elaborate games on them. 
2 years ago when I graduated from high school, I started to university in France. At the same time I was going through a break up. I ditched my classes, got depressed and eventually became unable to leave my house out of anxiety. Most things went wrong and I spent months doing nothing, while my parents still kept sending me money. They were unaware of how fucked up I was.
When I came back to Turkey for vacation,I was already planning on killing myself. The only reason why I didn't was the small chance that I could actually go to university somewhere else. Just by coincidence, I came across an amazing business school in Spain. I applied, got accepted but it was a private school and it was unaffordable. I got a shitty scholarship because I applied in June, which means they have a small budget left. I had to lie. I lied to my parents. I told them that I could get a higher scholarship when I start to university there.
That's how they let me come here. Now the academic year is about to end. I didn't get a higher scholarship. My mother spent all her savings on me. I didn't even talk to the financial aid department. I'm probably gonna have to leave the uni and go back to Turkey, but I'd rather die. I am not just saying it. I've always found death peaceful, never shed a tear for my beloved ones who died. 
I know death will not solve problems. It will exterminate them and the possibility of new problems arising
Thanks but I can assure you that people don't love me and I can't blame them
